facts.value: This program is designed to build technical expertise while allowing you to explore topics across the boundaries of traditional disciplines. Courses are taught by leading faculty members and researchers in engineering, physics, chemistry and more. With two core courses and a variety of technical electives from which to choose, you can customize your study plan to fit your goals. The program culminates in your choice of a thesis, portfolio or applied project course.
